title: US equity markets close early at 1:00 p.m. ET — the day after Thanksgiving 2028
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes). Footnote *** on the Thanksgiving Day row reads verbatim: 'Each market will close early at 1:00 p.m. (1:15 p.m. for eligible options) on Friday, November 27, 2026, Friday, November 26, 2027, and Friday, November 24, 2028 (the day after Thanksgiving). NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m. All times are Eastern Time.' The 2028 date is named explicitly in the footnote text, not inferred from the Thursday. Filed estimate on the same two counts as every sibling half-day entry (thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27, thanksgiving-half-day-2027-11-26): the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange operator's hours page (open issue #2552), and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
